1160.title: Integral Neural Networks
1160.abstract: Integral Neural Networks represent layer weights as continuous functions over filter and channel dimensions and replace discrete transformations with integration. At inference time, numerical quadrature converts the continuous layers to ordinary tensors at adjustable discretizations. Across multiple architectures and tasks, the paper reports conventional-model performance while preserving accuracy under structural pruning without fine-tuning, including about a 2% ImageNet accuracy loss for a 30%-pruned ResNet-18 compared with about 65% for the conventional pruning comparison.
